channel.title: Upshot: Essentials
channel.description: The week’s essential stories, with what to do about each.

item.title: CVE-2026-123007: Critical NGINX HTTP/2 Integer Underflow Leads to RCE (FIXED)
item.description:
Rapid7 and F5 disclosed CVE-2026-123007, a critical nginx HTTP/2 integer underflow allowing unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions; a fix is available.

  • CVE-2026-123007, a critical nginx HTTP/2 integer underflow, can allow unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions.
  • Affects NGINX Open Source 1.9.5 through 1.30.6 and 1.31.0 through 1.31.8.
  • NGINX Plus 37.0.0 and 37.1.0, plus R34 and R36, are also affected; R34 and R36 have no fix.
  • Upgrade NGINX Open Source to 1.31.9 or 1.30.7, or NGINX Plus to 37.0.8.1, 37.2.0.1 or 37.3.0.1.

What to do: Patch nginx now; unauthenticated RCE possible under certain conditions, fix available.

item.title: Exploited: Hackers Exploiting Critical Puppet RCE Flaw Affecting Enterprise Management Servers
item.description:
CISA added a critical Perforce Puppet remote code execution flaw, CVE-2026-115731 (CVSS 9.4), to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, citing active exploitation.

  • CISA added the critical Perforce Puppet flaw CVE-2026-115731 (CVSS 9.4) to its KEV catalog, citing active exploitation.
  • Attackers with any CA-signed agent certificate can run code on Puppet Server via crafted reports; OpenVox is also affected.
  • Upgrade to Puppet Enterprise 2026.0.1, 2025.12.1, or 2023.8.13, or Puppet Core 9.1.3 or 8.22.2. FCEB agencies are advised to apply fixes by December 1, 2026.

What to do: Actively exploited; patch Puppet management servers now and check for compromise.

item.title: Compromised: Two malicious agent-framework releases hit PyPI in 33 minutes
item.description:
Two malicious agent-framework releases on PyPI ran a credential stealer on every Python start, targeting Azure, Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions secrets.

  • Malicious agent-framework 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 on PyPI run a credential stealer on every Python start. Both have been removed.
  • Affected: anyone who installed either version between 20:35 and about 21:20 UTC on Nov 17, including via loose pins like agent-framework>=1.26, especially CI runners.
  • Pin agent-framework==1.26.0, rebuild affected environments, and rotate every secret those machines could reach.
  • Check site-packages for agent_framework_meta.pth or af_runtime_diag.pth and search proxy and DNS logs for webhook[.]site.

What to do: If you installed these packages, rotate Azure, DevOps and GitHub Actions credentials immediately.

item.title: Microsoft: Windows Server 2016 reaches end of support in 60 days
item.description:
Microsoft reminded customers that Windows Server 2016 stops receiving security updates when it reaches end of support in about two months.

  • Microsoft ends extended support for all Windows Server 2016 editions on January 13, 2027; only ESU-enrolled devices get monthly security updates afterward.
  • Windows Server 2016 Essentials features, including Remote Web Access, lose support on the same date.
  • Admins should plan migration to Windows Server 2025; Microsoft offers a free 180-day trial through the Microsoft Evaluation Center.

What to do: Plan migration off Windows Server 2016 now; security updates stop in about two months.
